title: Sodiboost
description: What happens when fedi makes a Minecrat mod.
body:
# The Sodiboost mod

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1362400131206348930?label=join%20luna's%20Discord%20server%20%3A3&style=plastic)](https://dcd.gg/luna)
[![Gitea Release](https://img.shields.io/gitea/v/release/luna/sodiboost?gitea_url=https%3A%2F%2Fgit.mldchan.dev&style=plastic)](https://git.mldchan.dev/luna/sodiboost/releases)
[![Forgejo Issues](https://img.shields.io/gitea/issues/open/luna/sodiboost?gitea_url=https%3A%2F%2Fgit.mldchan.dev&style=plastic)](https://git.mldchan.dev/luna/sodiboost/issues)
[![Forgejo Pull Requests](https://img.shields.io/gitea/pull-requests/open/luna/sodiboost?gitea_url=https%3A%2F%2Fgit.mldchan.dev&style=plastic)](https://git.mldchan.dev/luna/sodiboost/pulls)
[![Static Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/Follow%20%40luna%40fedi.mldchan.dev%20on%20fedi-ffaaff?style=plastic)
](https://fedi.mldchan.dev/users/luna)

This mod is the result of what happens when [you let fedi make a Minecraft mod](https://fedi.mldchan.dev/objects/b316256d-626d-4e61-acf0-37a2268fa7d2).

## Items

- The Sodiboo block - The base of this mod. Currently it doesn't naturally generate, that's planned together with animations for 1.1.0.
- Sodiboost item - Dropped from the Sodiboo block, can be used to craft a few items.
- The Sodiboost block - Not to be confused with the Sodiboo block
- An "Instance Moment" painting - This is the result of what happens when Sodiboo boosts all of your posts on your fedi instance. Peak 100% CPU moment.
- Sodiboost dimension, where all block are Sodiboo's.
- The Sodiboo biome, only spawning in the Sodiboost dimension.
- The Sodiboost igniter
- Fedi software blocks for [Mastodon](https://joinmastodon.org), [Pleroma](https://pleroma.social), [Misskey](https://misskey-hub.net), [Akkoma](https://akkoma.social), [Snac](https://codeberg.org/grunfink/snac2), [Sharkey](https://joinsharkey.org), [Iceshrimp](https://iceshrimp.dev), [Friendica](https://friendi.ca/) and [Wafrn](https://wafrn.net)
- Fedi items for [Mastodon](https://joinmastodon.org), [Pleroma](https://pleroma.social), [Misskey](https://misskey-hub.net), [Akkoma](https://akkoma.social), [Snac](https://codeberg.org/grunfink/snac2), [Sharkey](https://joinsharkey.org), [Iceshrimp](https://iceshrimp.dev), [Friendica](https://friendi.ca/) and [Wafrn](https://wafrn.net)
- The [fediblock](https://fedi.mldchan.dev/notice/B85q6XkktsfoZoGPQG)
- [Fediblock dimenion](https://fedi.mldchan.dev/notice/B86SDQ9DN8mpH2PWZE)
- Yellow water
- [Posting posts that warrant defederation](https://fedi.mldchan.dev/notice/B86WMw5iNMhklfZAkS)
- New death methods
- [Yaseen and white yaseen](https://fedi.fraw.st/notes/aoeg2i3qs32306dp)
- Paintings of [Mastodon](https://joinmastodon.org), [Pleroma](https://pleroma.social), [Misskey](https://misskey-hub.net), [Akkoma](https://akkoma.social), [Snac](https://codeberg.org/grunfink/snac2), [Sharkey](https://joinsharkey.org), [Iceshrimp](https://iceshrimp.dev), [Friendica](https://friendi.ca/) and [Wafrn](https://wafrn.net)

## Recipes

This mod has a bunch of recipes, here's a list:

- **Sodiboost Igniter**: 1 flint, 1 boost item
- **Fediblock**: 1 Mastodon, 1 Pleroma, 1 Misskey, 1 Akkoma, 1 Snac, 1 Sharkey, 1 Iceshrimp, 1 Friendica and 1 Wafrn items.
- **Fediblock Portal Igniter**: Smelt a fediblock.
- ***Fediverse software* blocks**: 4 *fediverse software* items like a crafting table
- **Misskoma**: 1 Mastodon, 1 Misskey, 1 Akkoma, 1 Sharkey, 1 Iceshrimp
- **Evil Fedi Block**: 4 evil fedi items
- **Painting**: 9 sodiboost items
- **Yaseen**: Can be spawned by placing 3 Akkoma blocks on top of each other
- **White Yaseen**: Can be spawned by placing 3 evil fedi blocks on top of each other
